title: AgnDiscord
body:
🚀 AgnDiscord v1.0 Released – Minecraft & Discord Integration

AgnDiscord bridges your Minecraft server with Discord seamlessly. Players can now send reports, suggestions, and bug reports directly from in-game to your Discord channels in a stylish and structured way.

Highlights:

/report <player> <reason> – Sends a player report with avatar and reason as an embed to Discord.

/suggest <suggestion> – Sends suggestions with auto ✅ / ❌ reactions.

/bugreport <issue> – Sends bug reports with embed formatting and built-in cooldown to prevent spam.

/agndiscordreload – Instantly reloads config and messages.

Other Features:

Cooldown System – Prevents command spam.

Modern Discord Integration – Powered by JDA 5 with full embed and emoji support.

Easy Configuration – Manage channel IDs, bot token, and messages via config.

Enhance communication between your players and staff with this lightweight, optimized plugin!
